comment: The Cyber Smash Burger was insane! Plus, playing Cyberpunk on 240Hz monitors while eating loaded fries is the ultimate vibe.
Booked the VR Holodeck for my birthday party. Staff were super helpful and the Quantum Blue Mana shake is 10/10!
Great sound system and neon lighting setup. Pizza Inferno was spicy and hot. Will definitely come back for LAN weekend!
